messages.content: To connect this project to a new GitHub repository, tap the **GitHub** icon at the top of the chat. Once you connect a repository there, your project and its full history will be pushed to it automatically.

I have imported the **[WeaverLawAgents](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/WeaverLawAgents)** repository into your workspace.

### Overview of Imported Structure

* **Core Documentation**:
  * [README.md](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/README.md): Overview of WeaverLawOS (v0.1.0 Foundation).
  * [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Developer and AI assistant guidelines, scope, and engineering rules.
  * [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Event-driven Google Cloud architecture (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Gemini).
  * [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Mandatory controls, data isolation, and permission boundaries.
  * [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): Staged milestones and acceptance gates.
* **Architecture & Standards** ([docs/](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/docs)):
  * Standards for agents, workflows, governance, threat models, and architectural decisions.
* **Agent Scaffolding** ([agents/](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/agents)):
  * Scaffolds for `criminal-defense`, `civil-litigation`, `domestic-relations`, `intake-clio`, `docket-calendar`, `evidence`, `legal-research`, `coo`, `senior-partner`, and `it-security`.
* **Workflows & Integrations** ([workflows/](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/workflows), [integrations/](https://github.com/mountainjusticelaw-spec/new-project/blob/main/integrations)):
  * Target workflows including `incoming-email`, `document-ingestion`, `deadline-review`, `daily-briefing`, and `matter-audit`.
  * Integration specs for Clio, Dropbox, Gmail, Google Calendar, and legal research tools.

All files are merged and ready. What component or milestone would you like to focus on first?
